subject: RStudio Server: Running with a Proxy - nginx

messages.author: f9ca1b61adbcd6fb
messages.subject: RStudio Server: Running with a Proxy - nginx
parts:
Hi all,

I follow the documentation in Rstudio-server doc pages for a custom location like this

location /rstudio/ {
  rewrite ^/rstudio/(.*)$ /$1 break;
  proxy_pass http://localhost:8787;
  proxy_redirect http://localhost:8787/ $scheme://$host/rstudio/;
}

but with preview version 0.98.932, the R Markdown Presentation doesn't work. I received an error
